fields.description: Issue includes local political commentary and election coverage focused on Miami Beach and Miami, including discussion of mayoral and council races and civic governance. Contains an editorial on proposed taxation and regulation affecting bars and beer-selling licenses in Dade County, along with commentary on policing and public conduct (including a satirical/feature piece presenting a “Coppers’ Courtesy Code”). Also includes society and nightlife notes, entertainment and club advertising, radio program schedules, and sports/racing-related content and promotions.
